propositions: Introduce a dedicated rotation module that loads/saves GET-rotation sidecar state with fail-open semantics and max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value) lookup per Jira key during dual-write rollout.

Dual-write every new rotation stamp to both the sidecar file and legacy inline field so interleaved old/new binaries see consistent progress; persist sidecar only through BindingStore.save() paths that cover end-of-pass, write-ahead, recovery, and retirement saves.
Wire BindingStore and outbound_differ to shared rotation accessors while keeping outbound_differ at or below 800 lines.
Stage and commit both dual-written rotation files (.bridge_state/get_rotation.json and legacy inline field) in one local commit without git add -A via explicit staging list in reconcile_helpers.py.

A pass with no absent-key GETs leaves all committed bridge-state files byte-identical and does not advance HEAD after initialization; a pass with absent-key GETs advances the same Jira-key stamps in both representations.
reconcile-check against pre-migration stores uses persist=False and leaves git status clean without creating get_rotation.json sidecar.
